subject: general
question: What is the function of WinZip?

options.text: It expands smaller files into a large file.
It compresses large files into a smaller file.
It extracts smaller files from larger files.

solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**It compresses large files into a smaller file.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **WinZip** is a Windows program that lets you archive and compress files so that you can store or distribute them more efficiently.
 
• WinZip is a more capable and easier-to-use Windows equivalent of two earlier programs commonly used in the** DOS** operating system.
 
• WinZip has a simple drag-and-drop **interface** that allows you **to view individual files in a zip file** **without unzipping the file**.
 
• WinZip will also launch **installation** programs from a zip file and automatically **clean up** after the installation.
 
• When creating a zip file (or archive), you can choose from five levels of compression.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **To expands smaller files into a large file** - Open that folder, then select File, New, Compressed (zipped) folder. Type a name for the compressed folder and press enter
 
• **Antivirus software**, also known as anti-malware, is a computer program used to prevent, detect, and remove malware.
 
• **To extract smaller file from larger file** - Go to the folder which contains the file or subfolder you want to compress. Note that the file you are about to compress must not be open in any program. Right-click the file or folder. Select Send to, and then in the next submenu, select Compressed (zipped) folder.
